messages:
alex (CEO): Quick weekly from me — short, practical asks. 1) Private EU beta: rollout is on Monday AM CET; Maria will lead the cutover and we expect <24h monitoring window. 2) Data retention: new default log TTL 30d for hosted projects, request exemptions via security reviews. 3) Incident last Thursday: root cause was a scheduling regression in batcher; Kevin's fix reduced error rate to <0.05%. 4) Metrics: p50 gen latency 68ms, p95 320ms, hosted token cost down 12% quarter-over-quarter. Please read Maria's detailed notes below. :rocket:

maria (VP Ops): TL;DR: EU private beta greenlighted. Cutover checklist pinned in #release-war-room. Key operational changes: - rolling verification policy for Dedicated pools - enforced KMS key rotation every 90 days for Private customers - default logs -> 30d, archive flows for compliance (contact @security). Expect targeted support hours for the first 72h post-launch.

sam (Head of Product): Thanks Alex/Maria. Product asks for next week: (a) enable model pins per-customer (canary to 10% then 100%), (b) quick UX for retention settings in Console. Priorities mapped in the drive: /product/roadmap/private-eu-beta.md. Small note: evaluate customer feedback form for onboarding — short pulse survey.

kevin (Eng Lead): Incident follow-up: fix merged (PR #5123). The scheduling regression happened when a fast path bypassed rate-limiter checks; added gate and unit tests. Rollout on canary completed, full-prod rolling patch at 02:00 UTC tonight. Observability: added a metric batcher.queue_delay_ms and alert when >250ms for 5m.

ops-bot: deploy bot: Canary deployment started for canary=beta-eu at 2023-11-19T02:00:00Z. sha=ab12c3f.

maria (VP Ops): Action items (everyone): 1) Eng: validate canary metrics and escalate any 5xx spike. 2) Support: prioritize EU private beta tickets; use "EU-BETA" tag. 3) Product: enable retention toggle UI by EOD Thursday. 4) Security: review any requested retention exemptions within 48h. I'll host a 30m sync Friday 09:30 PT.

alex (CEO): One final ask — keep comms short to customers: two bullets: what changed, what to expect. We'll share an external-facing note after the Friday sync. Thanks all, big week. :thumbsup:
